data.one_liner: A scale ruler widget for measuring lengths in centimeters or feet and inches.
data.what_it_does: Provides a horizontal or vertical scale ruler widget that allows users to pick length values in centimeters or feet and inches. It supports custom controllers, major tick intervals, value indicators during drag operations, and standard slider states like enabled and change callbacks.
use_when: You need to let users input length measurements in feet/inches or centimeters.
You want a ruler-style slider widget for horizontal or vertical orientations.
avoid_when: You need standard linear sliders without measurement unit ticks or scales.
You require complex form validation outside of standard slider value changes.
strengths: Supports both metric (centimeters) and imperial (feet and inches) units.
Provides horizontal and vertical orientation options.
Includes a controller to programmatically manage ruler state and thumb position.
weaknesses: Not documented for extensive custom graphics beyond basic color and height options.
